display.title: Saved by Negel Vasser: Rabbi Akiva in Prison
display.summary_short: Rabbi Akiva, jailed for teaching Torah, uses his only jug of water to wash his hands and make a brachah, and the amazed ruler frees him and makes him his advisor.
display.summary_long: A story from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. In Rabbi Akiva's time, learning and teaching Torah was forbidden, yet he trusted in Hashem and kept teaching in public. He is thrown into a crowded cell with criminals, and the wardens give the prisoners no food or water for three days. When jugs of water are finally brought in, the ruler happens to pass by. The other prisoners gulp the water down, but Rabbi Akiva pours his over his fingers and makes the brachah for washing negel vasser. Astonished that a thirsty prisoner would use his water for a mitzvah, the ruler has him released and brought to the palace, soon recognizes his wisdom, and makes him his advisor, while the other prisoners are punished. Uncle Yossi draws the lessons: Rabbi Akiva served Hashem with all his heart and soul, and when we keep mitzvos with firm faith, Hashem blesses us with success.
display.lesson: Cherish every mitzvah even when it is hard; when we keep Hashem's mitzvos with firm faith, Hashem blesses us with success.
